All numerical expectations are independent Julia/C-contract observations or actual C aggregation outputs; no Rust result was used as an expectation.
Short prefixes override both NSROptItrStep and NSROptItrSmp to 1/2/3/50 explicitly; no min(prefix,canonical_window) rule is used.
Canonical native long gates preserve original steps/window/seed; they are different averaging workloads from these labelled prefixes.
Window 1 C output emits real(value),0 pairs without CalcAveVar or a deviation field. Window>1 uses centered squared magnitudes and sample deviation; no negative-variance clamp or nonfinite sanitization is applied.
Current standalone C histories/results are finite; general nonfinite input behavior is outside this fixture domain.
